content.Summary: The 2021 ACC/AHA/SCAI Coronary Revascularization Guideline discusses interventions like percutaneous coronary intervention and coronary artery bypass graft surgery. It emphasizes the management of coronary artery disease, including various surgical and non-surgical strategies, in patients with conditions like valvular heart disease, heart failure, and other cardiovascular complications. Key terms include angioplasty, stents, myocardial revascularization, multivessel PCI, and left ventricular dysfunction.
